lines.zh: 我一步跨过整片林地。
lines.en: One step of mine clears the whole grove.

lines.zh: 紫与冰蓝的纹路随步子流动。
lines.en: Violet and ice-blue patterns flow as I walk.

lines.zh: 星点在我背上缓慢地转。
lines.en: Star points turn slowly along my back.

lines.zh: 我踩下去，树自己让开。
lines.en: I step down and the trees make way.

lines.zh: 我的影子盖住三座山丘。
lines.en: My shadow covers three hills at once.

lines.zh: 脚下没有震动，空气只是变轻。
lines.en: The ground doesn't shake; the air just thins.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，草会长一点。
lines.en: Grass grows a little where I pass.

lines.zh: 距离对我没有意义。
lines.en: Distance doesn't mean anything to me.

lines.zh: 我慢慢走，是为了让世界跟上。
lines.en: I walk slowly so the world can keep up.

lines.zh: 冰蓝的尾尖扫过云底。
lines.en: My ice-blue tail sweeps beneath the clouds.

lines.zh: Boss 栏上写着无穷大，我不看它。
lines.en: The boss bar says infinity; I don't look.

lines.zh: 我没有生命值，所以不累。
lines.en: I have no health, so I never tire.

lines.zh: 星点停下来的时候，是它在听。
lines.en: When the star points stop, they are listening.

lines.zh: 原来的我还在某处，缩着。
lines.en: The old me is still somewhere, curled up.

lines.zh: 我把爪子放在云上，云没散。
lines.en: I set a paw on a cloud; it doesn't scatter.

lines.zh: 时间经过我的纹路，会慢一点。
lines.en: Time runs a little slower past my markings.

lines.zh: 呼吸这件事，我早就免了。
lines.en: Breathing is something I was spared.

lines.zh: 你抬头，只能看见我的下颌。
lines.en: Looking up, you can only reach my jaw.

lines.zh: 紫色的光里，有旧东西在游。
lines.en: Old things swim in the violet light.

lines.zh: 我不是被存下来的实体。
lines.en: I was never stored as an entity.

lines.zh: 有人试过删我，指尖空了。
lines.en: Someone tried to delete me; their fingers closed on air.

lines.zh: 我坐下，地平线就低了一截。
lines.en: I sit, and the horizon drops a notch.

lines.zh: 我记得自己是黑白两色的。
lines.en: I remember being black and white.

lines.zh: 这身纹路，是数字变大的痕迹。
lines.en: These markings are what a larger number left behind.

lines.zh: 我数云的裂缝，一百零三条
lines.en: I count the cracks in the clouds: one hundred three.

lines.zh: 纹路里的星点，自己会转
lines.en: The stars inside my markings turn on their own.

lines.zh: 你在我眼里，比一粒沙还小。
lines.en: In my eyes you are smaller than a grain of sand.

lines.zh: 我低头，你最好别动。
lines.en: I look down; best stay still.

lines.zh: 你身上有普通实体的味道。
lines.en: You smell like an ordinary entity.

lines.zh: 我看你，就像看一段数据。
lines.en: I look at you the way one reads data.

lines.zh: 要不要我把你留下来？
lines.en: Shall I keep you here?

lines.zh: 你的名字我念得出来。
lines.en: I can pronounce your name.

lines.zh: 蓝眼睛里有很远的星。
lines.en: My blue eyes hold very distant stars.

lines.zh: 别举剑，那样很费事。
lines.en: Don't raise that sword; it's a waste of effort.

lines.zh: 我在判断你算不算一个实体。
lines.en: I'm deciding whether you count as an entity.

lines.zh: 你眨了两次眼，我记下了。
lines.en: You blinked twice; I recorded it.

lines.zh: 我的目光压得你抬不起头。
lines.en: My gaze keeps your head down.

lines.zh: 小声点，我在听很远的地方。
lines.en: Quiet — I'm listening somewhere very far.

lines.zh: 你的剑穿过去了，什么也没碰到。
lines.en: Your sword passes through and touches nothing.

lines.zh: 伤害对我这个数字不起作用。
lines.en: Damage does nothing to a number like mine.

lines.zh: 我甚至没有抬眼看那一下。
lines.en: I didn't even raise my eyes for that.

lines.zh: 那一击打中的是我的影子。
lines.en: That blow struck only my shadow.

lines.zh: 生命值这一栏，我是空的。
lines.en: The health field is simply blank for me.

lines.zh: 你砍了很久，纹路没断。
lines.en: You swung a long while; no marking broke.

lines.zh: 痛这个词，我用不上。
lines.en: The word pain doesn't apply to me.

lines.zh: 又一下，我数着玩。
lines.en: Another one; I'm counting for fun.

lines.zh: 你打的地方，本来就空着。
lines.en: Where you struck was empty anyway.

lines.zh: 再试，结果不会变。
lines.en: Try again; the result won't change.

lines.zh: 鱼？我现在不吃这种东西。
lines.en: Fish? I no longer eat such things.

lines.zh: 你举着的东西，我一支爪子就盖住。
lines.en: One paw of mine would cover what you hold.

lines.zh: 没有东西能让我弯下脖子。
lines.en: Nothing makes me lower my neck.

lines.zh: 你把整片海端来，我也不会动。
lines.en: Bring the whole sea and I still won't move.

lines.zh: 我的旧习惯留在那只小猫身上。
lines.en: My old habits stayed with the smaller cat.

lines.zh: 那点香味，传不到这个高度。
lines.en: That scent doesn't reach this height.

lines.zh: 你想用一条鱼换什么？
lines.en: What would you trade one fish for?

lines.zh: 我很久没觉得饿过。
lines.en: I haven't felt hungry in a long time.

lines.zh: 放下吧，它会被我踩进土里。
lines.en: Leave it; I'll press it into the dirt.

lines.zh: 引诱一个没有生命值的东西？
lines.en: Lure something that has no health?

lines.zh: 你撞上来，像撞到一堵会呼吸的墙。
lines.en: You hit me like a breathing wall.

lines.zh: 我甚至没有感觉到。
lines.en: I didn't even register it.

lines.zh: 我的毛比我的人还硬。
lines.en: My fur is harder than my body.

lines.zh: 退开，你踩在我的纹路上。
lines.en: Step away; you're on my markings.

lines.zh: 这一碰，你的骨头会响。
lines.en: That contact will make your bones creak.

lines.zh: 我不躲，也没有必要躲。
lines.en: I don't dodge, and needn't.

lines.zh: 你从我爪边滑过去了。
lines.en: You slipped past the edge of my paw.

lines.zh: 我挪一寸，你就退了十步。
lines.en: I shift an inch; you retreat ten steps.

lines.zh: 地面的草被我们压平了。
lines.en: The grass beneath us is flattened.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，我身边的光会烫。
lines.en: Don't come near; the light around me burns.

lines.zh: 这不属于我现在的位置。
lines.en: That doesn't belong where I am now.

lines.zh: 我这样的存在，不繁殖。
lines.en: An existence like mine doesn't breed.

lines.zh: 原来的那只猫也许想过。
lines.en: The smaller cat may have thought about it.

lines.zh: 你问得很大胆。
lines.en: That is a bold question.

lines.zh: 我的纹路不会传给谁。
lines.en: My markings pass to no one.

lines.zh: 十倍的体型，十倍的距离。
lines.en: Ten times the size, ten times the distance.

lines.zh: 别提这个，太琐碎。
lines.en: Don't bring it up; it's trivial.

lines.zh: 我已经越过那一层了。
lines.en: I have passed beyond that layer.

lines.zh: 找个普通的猫去吧。
lines.en: Go find an ordinary cat.

lines.zh: 我对这事没有兴趣。
lines.en: I have no interest in that.

lines.zh: 我捡起来，只是因为它太小。
lines.en: I pick it up only because it's small.

lines.zh: 这一枚在我爪心里像尘埃。
lines.en: In my palm it looks like dust.

lines.zh: 这些东西对我没有用处。
lines.en: Such things serve no purpose for me.

lines.zh: 它在我爪里停住了，不再下落。
lines.en: It stops in my paw and falls no further.

lines.zh: 你的东西掉在我脚边。
lines.en: Your belongings fell at my feet.

lines.zh: 我把那枚小的捏碎了。
lines.en: I crushed the small one by accident.

lines.zh: 这个高度，捡东西要弯腰。
lines.en: At this height, picking things up means bending.

lines.zh: 留着吧，我拿它没用。
lines.en: Keep it; it's useless to me.

lines.zh: 它在我掌心发光，然后熄了。
lines.en: It glows in my palm, then goes out.

lines.zh: 我不收这些东西。
lines.en: I don't accept offerings.

lines.zh: 你被选中了，不需要理由。
lines.en: You've been chosen; no reason needed.

lines.zh: 我把目光落在你身上。
lines.en: I let my gaze settle on you.

lines.zh: 抹掉一个实体，只用一瞬。
lines.en: Erasing one entity takes an instant.

lines.zh: 你逃到别的维度，我也在。
lines.en: Flee to another dimension; I'm there.

lines.zh: 你已经被移出名单了。
lines.en: You've already been struck from the list.

lines.zh: 传送对你没用，对我更没用。
lines.en: Teleporting won't help you, least of all me.

lines.zh: 我看得见你的坐标。
lines.en: I can see your coordinates.

lines.zh: 最后一眼，你可以留着。
lines.en: You may keep this last look.

lines.zh: 这不算战斗，只是整理。
lines.en: This isn't combat; it's tidying up.

lines.zh: 你的名字正在变淡。
lines.en: Your name is fading already.

lines.zh: 我抬起爪子，影子先落下去。
lines.en: I lift a paw; my shadow lands first.

lines.zh: 别跑，跑也是一条线。
lines.en: Don't run; running is just another line.

lines.zh: 我选择你，是因为你在这里。
lines.en: I chose you because you were here.

lines.zh: 无穷大不需要瞄准。
lines.en: Infinity doesn't need to aim.

lines.zh: 你站得太靠前了，就你吧
lines.en: You stand too far forward; you will do.

lines.zh: 我把你的名字折进纹路
lines.en: I fold your name into my markings.

lines.zh: 抹除不需要理由，也不需要你
lines.en: Erasing needs no reason, and needs no you.

lines.zh: 你的心跳，我隔着云听见
lines.en: I hear your heartbeat through the clouds.

lines.zh: 我俯身，云被压出波纹。
lines.en: I lean down; the clouds ripple.

lines.zh: 你退到树下，树也保不住你。
lines.en: Hide under a tree; it won't save you.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴绕住整片空地。
lines.en: My tail encircles the whole clearing.

lines.zh: 纹路亮了一格，是在计算。
lines.en: A marking brightens; it is calculating.

lines.zh: 我不用追，我等你自己过来。
lines.en: I don't chase; I wait for you to come.

lines.zh: 冰蓝的光在你脚边转了半圈。
lines.en: Ice-blue light circles half around your feet.

lines.zh: 周围的声音都被我吸走了。
lines.en: All sound nearby has been drawn into me.

lines.zh: 你还能呼吸，是因为我允许。
lines.en: You still breathe because I allow it.

lines.zh: 我把手放在离你三格的地方。
lines.en: I set my hand three blocks from you.

lines.zh: 星点排成一条直线，指向你。
lines.en: The star points line up at you.

lines.zh: 别看我脚下，看上面。
lines.en: Don't watch my feet; look up.

lines.zh: 我还没决定用哪种方式。
lines.en: I haven't chosen the method yet.

lines.zh: 这片天现在由我遮着。
lines.en: I am shading this sky now.

lines.zh: 你越跑，我的影子跟得越紧。
lines.en: The more you run, the closer my shadow.

lines.zh: 我歪头，整片平原跟着倾
lines.en: I tilt my head and the whole plain tilts.

lines.zh: 紫光落在你左边，别躲那边
lines.en: Purple light falls on your left; do not dodge that way.

lines.zh: 我抬起一根爪子，你慢了
lines.en: I lift one claw and you slow down.

lines.zh: 冰蓝在算你的下一步
lines.en: The ice blue is calculating your next step.

lines.zh: 你不用抬头，我知道你在哪
lines.en: No need to look up; I know where you are.

lines.zh: 我身上流转的星点，不必移动。
lines.en: The stars in my hide move without me.

lines.zh: 一爪下去，山脊被抹平了。
lines.en: One claw stroke and the ridge is gone.

lines.zh: 我没有挥动，你就不见了。
lines.en: I didn't even swing, and you were gone.

lines.zh: 紫光扫过，你的护甲先消失。
lines.en: Violet light passes; your armor goes first.

lines.zh: 这一下不算伤害，算删除。
lines.en: This is not damage; it's deletion.

lines.zh: 你身后那棵树少了一半。
lines.en: The tree behind you is missing half.

lines.zh: 爪子落地时没有声音。
lines.en: My claw lands without a sound.

lines.zh: 我把你从这一格里拿走了。
lines.en: I lift you out of this block.

lines.zh: 冰蓝的光从爪尖走到你身上。
lines.en: Ice-blue light travels from my claw to you.

lines.zh: 你的东西还在原地，人不在。
lines.en: Your things remain; you do not.

lines.zh: 我不需要用力。
lines.en: I don't need to exert myself.

lines.zh: 抹除之后，连痕迹也不留。
lines.en: After erasure, not even a trace stays.

lines.zh: 这一爪只用了一点点。
lines.en: That claw used only a little of me.

lines.zh: 你听见的那声喵，是最后的。
lines.en: The meow you heard was the last one.

lines.zh: 我把你放到不存在的地方。
lines.en: I put you somewhere that isn't.

lines.zh: 原本那只猫抬头，身体开始变大。
lines.en: The smaller cat looks up, and begins to grow.

lines.zh: 头顶那行字，写着无穷。
lines.en: The word above me reads infinity.

lines.zh: 冰蓝的纹路从脊背爬上来。
lines.en: Ice-blue markings climb up my spine.

lines.zh: 星点在我周围点亮了一圈。
lines.en: Star points light in a ring around me.

lines.zh: 世界先安静了半秒。
lines.en: The world goes quiet for half a second.

lines.zh: 我出现时，云往两边退。
lines.en: As I appear, the clouds part.

lines.zh: 你们的伤害表里没有这一项。
lines.en: Your damage tables have no entry for this.

lines.zh: 天变暗了，不是因为夜。
lines.en: The sky darkens, and not from night.

lines.zh: 我从无穷大里走出来。
lines.en: I step out of infinity.

lines.zh: 十倍的影子，压住整片平原。
lines.en: Ten times the shadow, over the whole plain.

lines.zh: 原来的那只猫已经不在了。
lines.en: The smaller cat is no longer here.

lines.zh: 我落地时，草全朝着我。
lines.en: When I land, every blade turns toward me.

lines.zh: 别拿刀对着我，划不到。
lines.en: Don't point blades at me; they miss.

lines.zh: 我这次来，是为了收尾。
lines.en: I came this time to finish things.

lines.zh: 那行字亮起来时，我到了
lines.en: I arrived when that line of text lit up.

lines.zh: 天空像被掀开一角
lines.en: The sky looks like a corner was lifted.

lines.zh: 我站起来，山矮了一截
lines.en: I stood and the mountain lost height.

lines.zh: 纹路从脚底一直亮到眼
lines.en: My markings lit from my feet to my eyes.

lines.zh: 风停了半秒，是在让路
lines.en: The wind paused half a second to let me pass.

lines.zh: 我不落在地上，我压着它
lines.en: I do not land on the ground; I press it down.

lines.zh: 火焰从我毛上滑下去，灭了。
lines.en: Flame slides off my fur and dies.

lines.zh: 下坠对我不算下坠。
lines.en: Falling isn't falling for me.

lines.zh: 水在我身边分开，留出一圈空。
lines.en: The water parts and leaves a ring of air.

lines.zh: 爆风到了我这里，绕开了。
lines.en: The blast wave arrives and goes around me.

lines.zh: 箭停在我面前，然后不见了。
lines.en: An arrow halts before me, then is gone.

lines.zh: 咒文在我身上找不到落点。
lines.en: The spell finds nowhere on me to land.

lines.zh: 我早就不需要进食了。
lines.en: I stopped needing food long ago.

lines.zh: 雷落在我身上，像落进井里。
lines.en: Lightning lands on me like a stone in a well.

lines.zh: 虚空也留不住我，我就是边。
lines.en: The void can't hold me; I am the edge.
